impact: A binary event for the NBIS position: CoreWeave's beat and raise sets a supportive tone, but a 17% implied move means a miss on capacity or run-rate guidance could hit hard. The read-through also matters for MU and DRAM demand.
summary: Nebius reports Q3 2026 results before the open on Thursday, Nov 12, with a call at 8:00 a.m. ET. Analysts expect revenue of about $905M to $907M (range $877M to $943M) vs $582.3M in Q2, and a loss of roughly $0.61 to $0.72 per share. Options imply a move of about 17%, and investors will watch capacity guidance, 2027 run-rate targets and capex.
title: Nebius reports Q3 Thursday premarket; consensus about $906M revenue, options price ~17% move
